tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gu ru drag dmar gyi rjes gnang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /ma rung thal bar rlog mdzad thod phreng rtsal/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /gong gi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bshad/ gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs kyi khar mañji'i steng du maṇ+ḍal gyi khar rdul tshon dmar po'i zla gam sgo gcig khyams ljang dang mu khyud sngon po'i dbus su tshom bu dmar po/ de'i mdun du dpal gtor/ gtor gdugs bcas kyi mthar slob ma la ster rgyu'i mtheb skyu gang mang g.yas su sman phud/ g.yon du rak+ta/ mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod mchod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas su gsung rten/ thod pa'i nang du bdud rtsi/ g.yon du thugs rten lcags kyi rdo rje/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ slob ma la dgos pa'i chab/ maṇ+ḍal/ me tog gu gul rnams 'dus byas la/ bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo gu ru drag po la bdag gzhan skyabs su 'gro bar mos nas ngag tu/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin byang chub sems/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun la dgongs su gsol/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma mchog /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro la/ /sgo gsum dang bas skyabs su mchi/ /zhes bdun nam nyer gcig brjod la/ skyabs yul rang la thim par bsam/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral phyir/ /de nas byang chub mchis bar du/ /bla ma bsgrub par sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis gu ru drag por gsal ba'i snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i gu ru drag po la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+raḥs mā dzaḥ

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags/ /gsang sngags bsgrub la rjes yi rangs/ /smin grol gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /snying po sems can don du bsngo/ /yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /lan gsum/ sman rag gtor gsum la dmigs te rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor tshul dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod ban+dha 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sman rag gtor gsum ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta ba la ba ti gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ pad 'khyil gyi phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ de rnams lan gsum gsum/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ di paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta ma hā pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na kaṃ ni ri ti ma hā pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya ma hā pū dza hoḥ zhes lan re brjod de byin gyis brlabs/ shu n+ya tas snod bcud thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i rtsibs re la lcags sdig kha dgus mtshan pa g.yas su 'khor zhing / me 'bar ba'i 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor bas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sogs lan gsum/ de nas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs zhing rgya che ba'i nang du rlung gi dkyil 'khor/

rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keng rus kyi ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i steng du me rlung dmar nag gi dbus su gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ nang ni rim bzhin mi mgo skam rlon rid po'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ tshangs pho mo'i ka gdung / g.yang gzhi bla bre/ rgyu ma'i drwa phyed/ glo snying gi 'phan tshar 'phyang ba/ sgo bzhir zhing gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba'i drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma nyi ma zla ba srin po zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkha' la phyar zhing / g.yon lcags sdig kha dgu'i sked nas bzung ste thur du brkyangs ba/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ glang lpags dang g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs shing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dbu gtsug tu mkha' lding sngon po/ dpral bar 'jam dpal zhi khro ser po ral gri dang pusti 'dzin cing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po rdo rje dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub/

snying khar phyag rdor nag po rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub/ gsang gnas su yak+ṣa me dbal nag po rdo rje dang tho ba 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang khro bo'i cha lugs can/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas bdag la thim pas dbang bskur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i+i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta ma hā ba ling ta/ rak+ta pi pa tha āḥhūm̐ gis sman raka gtor gsum phul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ rang byung pad+ma thod phreng drag po'i sku/ /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad cing / /'khor ba ma lus dregs pa'i dpal gyur pa'i/ /gu ru drag po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ bzlas pa ni/ thugs ka'i phyag rdor hūm̐ dang bcas pa'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas spyan drangs nas rang la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nertsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang mdun bskyed las phye che ba'i che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku gyur/

zhes brjod/ slob ma khrus byas phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas gral 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed sngon 'gro'i lo rgyus rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bshad la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gnon sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /sogs lan gsum/ yang de rnams kyi spyan sngar phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs nas/ yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog gi bar lan gsum/ dngos gzhi la rjes gnang gi gzhi lus 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gu ru drag po dngos yin snyam pas gus 'dud drag po dung pa re byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog sogs rjes gnang spyi 'gres bzhin dang / shu n+ya ta'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ mthing nag ces pa nas bdag la thim ste dbang bskur gyi bar gong bzhin la khyed rang rnams zhes pa'i tshig bsgyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad ma hā gu ru'i sku'i rnam par spyan drangs sogs rjes gnang spyi 'gre ltar byas la/

ḍā dril rol mo bdug pa sngags bcas kyis ye shes dbab/ de brtan pa'i ched du/ gtor ma gu rus gsol ba'i lhag ma gu ru'i skur gsal ba spyi bor bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /yi dam rnams kyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir/ /dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur nas/ /sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ /lus kyi sgrib pa byang gyur nas/ /sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni artsig nirtsig sogs kyi mthar kā ya a bhi ṣīñca oṃ/ zhes brjod la gtor dum byin/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas lus kyi sgo nas sogs rjes gnang spyi 'gre/ thod chang mgrin par bzhag cing kha nang du sbyin pas gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥ bla ma rnams kyi༞ /yid dam༞ /mkha' 'gro༞ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas/ /gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ /ngag gi dri ma byang gyur nas/ /gsung gi snying po lung gi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣīñca āḥ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi ngag gi sgo nas sogs spyi 'gre/ lcags rdor khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar reg pas thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i༞ hūm̐ bla ma༞ /yi dam༞ /mkha' 'gro༞ /dam tshig rdo rje༞ /yid kyi sgrib pa༞ /thugs skye med kyi rdo rje'i༞ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ badz+ra sa mā ya tsit+ta a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi sogs spyi 'gre༞ bzlas lung spyi 'gre/ khyed rang rnams ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi skur gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ des che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi rjes gnang zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas sogs/

dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal phul deng nas brtsams te sogs 'dra/ bdag mdun gyi lha la mchod bstod gong bzhin/ yig brgya/ nongs pa bzod gsol mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rten dang brten par bcas pa rang la thim/ gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis rnams phrin las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /'di yang las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer ro// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ gu ru drag dmar gyi rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
